gloss: largest-class; of the highest degree; superlative

definitions.gloss: largest-class, maximum-scale, of the highest degree
definitions.explanation: Describes something that belongs to the very largest or most extreme category. Often used with の as a modifier to emphasize the superlative scale of something.

examples.japanese: {最大級|さいだいきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{接近|せっきん}している→接近する：25362_sekkinsuru⟧。
examples.english: A typhoon of the largest scale is approaching.

examples.japanese: {最大級|さいだいきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{賛辞|さんじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}りたい→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I want to offer the highest praise.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{観測史上|かんそくしじょう}{最大級|さいだいきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れ→揺れ：16137_yure⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}した→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: This earthquake recorded shaking of the largest magnitude ever observed.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧ (largest, maximum) and ⟦{級|きゅう}→級：28171_kyuu⟧ (class, grade, level). The suffix ⟦{級|きゅう}→級：28171_kyuu⟧ adds the meaning "of that class/rank," making the word function as a superlative intensifier.

USAGE:
Typically used as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {最大級|さいだいきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧ (a typhoon of the largest class). Very common in news reports and formal descriptions. The pattern 〜⟦{級|きゅう}→級：28171_kyuu⟧ is productive: {世界最大級|せかいさいだいきゅう} (of the world's largest class).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最大級|さいだいきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧: a typhoon of the largest scale
- {最大級|さいだいきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{賛辞|さんじ}: the highest praise
- {最大級|さいだいきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{警戒|けいかい}→警戒：14224_keikai⟧: the highest level of caution
- {世界最大級|せかいさいだいきゅう}: one of the largest in the world
- {史上最大級|しじょうさいだいきゅう}: one of the largest in history

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧: largest, maximum — the absolute superlative, without the "class" nuance
- ⟦{大規模|だいきぼ}→大規模：12185_daikibo⟧な: large-scale — describes the size of an event or operation
- {過去最大|かこさいだい}: the largest ever — specifically referring to historical records
